topics.title: Machine learning
topics.sourceDescription: User experiences powered by ML

web.rationale: Applicable to NovaPharm Intelligence search/ranking and model explanations as design obligations: no silent pharmaceutical certainty, distinguish accepted clinical facts from model inferences, show provenance and corrections, protect tenancy, require licensed data and avoid training or activating unapproved research models.

ios.rationale: Applicable to iOS ML-powered user journeys only when an approved signed feature actually exists; use clear user control, permissions, error correction and privacy boundaries with VoiceOver. Core ML/Create ML documentation does not itself prove any NovaPharm native deployment.

android.rationale: Applicable on Android as comparable model-transparency, privacy, source attribution and corrections goals; integrate only approved Android-capable inference and TalkBack behavior, never infer Core ML entitlement or signed Android app acceptance from Apple design guidance.

guidelineReviewEvidence: Official 2026-11-19 primary-source article inspection: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/machine-learning.md. Attribution and human-correctable results matter especially when incorrect suggestions have consequences.

ios.rationale: Directly applicable to native iOS VoiceOver: programmatically named controls, logical grouping, custom rotor navigation, predictable focus and dynamic content announcements verified on hardware.

android.rationale: Apple's VoiceOver-specific APIs and rotor are not Android OS features; Android equivalent must be independently reviewed and tested under TalkBack, accessibility services and Android UI semantics.
